name: @vantageos/mcp-doctor
stderr:
usage: mcp-doctor <source-tree-path> [--mode=static|dynamic|both] [--backend=<convex-dir>] [--json]
       mcp-doctor --url <https url> [--bearer-env VAR] [--header "Name: value"]... [--source DIR] [--expected-commit SHA] [--json]

  --mode=static   read the tree only (default)
  --mode=dynamic  launch the server and judge what it serves
  --mode=both     both, dynamic findings taking precedence
  --local-identity-ceiling=N
                  local identity primitives tolerated before DLocalIdentity
                  fails (default 0)
  --backend=DIR   the backend source (a convex/ dir) whose door list S-28 reads;
                  default: the nearest convex/ above the tree
  --url URL       judge a REMOTE streamable-HTTP server the way a customer reaches it (implies
                  dynamic; no launch target; https, or http on loopback only). Only the rules that
                  judge what a running server serves run; source-tree rules are not run
  --bearer-env VAR   send the token held in environment variable VAR as 'Authorization: Bearer'
                  (the token never appears on a command line or in output)
  --header "Name: value"   an extra request header (repeatable); values are never printed
  --source DIR    with --url: the server's source tree, for D8 eval counts and the C-25 expected
                  commit (git rev-parse HEAD there)
  --expected-commit SHA   with --url: the full commit id the server must serve (C-25)
  --json          print the report as JSON (results, owedHumanVerdicts, exitCode)
  --version       print the version and exit
  --help          print this and exit

exit: 0 clean, 1 a violation, 2 an abstention with no violation (including a target
      that names nothing readable: missing, empty, or not a source tree)
